key_insight: GMMag generates crystal structures with site-resolved magnetic moments and uses Gaussian-mixture sampling to steer chemistry and magnetism without retraining.
engineering_relevance: The workflow supports targeted magnetic-material discovery while estimating how repeated chemical formulas constrain distinct-candidate yield under a finite generation budget.
method: Conditional variational autoencoder with a graph neural network encoder and transformer decoder.
Gaussian-mixture sampling retargets generation toward selected chemical and magnetic properties.
Yield model accounts for repeated formulas when predicting accumulation of qualifying, previously unrepresented formulas.
evidence_signal: The study tests its yield model in two separate ten-million-draw runs and identifies Nd-containing candidates with formulas absent from the reference dataset, negative formation energies and high estimated saturation magnetization.
watch_item: Higher screening pass rates do not necessarily produce more distinct qualifying formulas, and predicted magnetic performance still requires validation.
paper_title: Magnetic crystal generation with site-resolved magnetic moments via Gaussian-mixture retargeting and finite-budget yield prediction
